title: The Kinrath Menace
description: Jorn Kess, a farmer in the Dantooine settlement, is desperate for help. The kinrath creatures have been getting bolder, coming closer to the settlement and attacking farms. Last week, they attacked one of the farms, and the settlers are afraid. They're not fighters, but they can't just abandon their homes. Can you help clear out the kinrath nest?
shortDescription: Clear out the kinrath nest threatening the settlement

objectives.description: Speak with farmer Jorn Kess about the kinrath problem
Locate the kinrath nest near the settlement
Defeat the kinrath creatures in the nest
Clear out the kinrath nest completely
Return to Jorn Kess to report success
